newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen heading higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen heading higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Friday morning, bolstered by a strong bond market reacting to comments made yesterday by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.
The market will also be following through on yesterday's volatile but finally upbeat session. But analysts said today could be slow in the absence of economic data.
U.S. Treasuries were higher, with the long bond up 17/32 to yield 6.89 percent.
